label: PF Backlog 509
title: E3: static high-risk-pattern corroboration (non-LLM) + ensure critical findings block the PR
body:
## Problem / why
Making production-risk review purely LLM leaves it unverifiable; a cheap static pass corroborates high-risk
patterns.

## Acceptance criteria
A non-LLM check scans changed code for high-risk patterns (SQL string concatenation, eval/exec, subprocess shell,
string-built queries, DELETE without WHERE) and surfaces findings the reviewer must address; the PR gate
(core/pr_gate.py) fails when the review verdict is not approved / critical findings are open.

## Out of scope
Full SAST tooling.
